desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 3 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> , creates 1 <color=#ffffff>Aedon</color> to your Hand.

<color=#ffd680>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Select 1 opposing character and deal 1 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> to them.

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 3 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> and creates <color=#ffffff>Nightingale's Song</color> with 3 Usage(s).
<color=#ebe4d8>Nightingale's Song</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
Enemy target takes +1 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> (Can stack, no stack limit)
After you bring forth a Summon, this card gains 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> .

<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) When a card whose name was not in your initial deck is added to your Hand, apply <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> to it. (Once per Round)

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)

<color=#ebe4d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ebe4d8>Combat Action</color>
After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ebe4d8>Cost Reduction</color>
Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)
